# kg-triple-extract

> Extract grounded subject-predicate-object triples from text with an injected LLM, verbatim evidence checks, predicate allowlists and a merged, normalised knowledge graph Python package `trysac-kg-triple-extract`, import name `kg_triple_extract`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
